question: Do same-report same-FY EPS and profit forecasts supply comparable revisions, or can denominator/rounding/sample differences confound them?
sources: R11 normalized forecasts and all cached EP24 report metadata; local only
pairing: exact infoCode, stock, broker and fiscal year; conflicting basis values unknown
implied_shares: profit_cny / eps_cny_per_share only for both positive; diagnostic not verified shares outstanding; no split/dilution adjustment inferred
sequence: same stock, broker and FY; include every cached report, simultaneous reports require all values known and identical; immediate prior only, gap <=365 days; no skipping missing reports
scope: FY0 and FY+1 at current publication; no future returns or model fitting
metrics: basis coverage, positive paired counts, within-pair symmetric revisions, sign disagreement and implied-share ratios; descriptive distributions, no outcome-selected thresholds
interpretation: rounding, dilution, profit-definition differences and extraction error remain alternatives; matching implied shares does not certify denominator comparability
next_gate: inspect fixed largest/smallest implied-share-change source examples before promoting EPS factor; no automatic correction or predictive acceptance
